posts.name: Boards Alive
posts.cooked:
Hey Everyone!

I am sure everyone is dying to know more about the Sentinel Comics RPG system and how it plays. So we here at Boards Alive decided to make yoru life easier. When we went to PAX West this year, we met up with Christopher and he GM'd a short session with us in the new system.

So if you've been dying to hear how the system plays, check out our episode with Christopher here - https://t.co/tL03bgELGM

We'd love to hear what you thought about our playthrough and if you think we sucked at playing some of the iconic heroes from the Sentinel Comics universe.
